scope: New prospective same-host release stream-write comparison; not the historical instrumented 126-process experiment, solver-quality certification, or R1 acceptance.
order: Per case: one warmup for each arm; seven measured blocks contain all six permutations once plus one cyclic extra permutation, then seeded shuffle. The extra rotates across River/Turn/Flop. Per-case position counts are 2/2/3; across all cases every arm occupies every position seven times.
cache_policy: Input SHA-256 before each invocation, plus example BLAKE3/read before writer timer. Warmups retained but excluded. No cache eviction. No concurrent build, download, or other experimental work during measure phase.

screen.rationale: Prospective descriptive screen: retain the earlier 5% improvement magnitude, require a majority of seven paired blocks, and use a new symmetric 5% regression guard. Not a confidence interval or calibrated R1 performance gate. A screen miss does not erase or invalidate a correctly completed run.
